summary: Aris Mining filed a 6-K attaching a news release announcing positive Prefeasibility Study results for its Toroparu gold project in Guyana. The PFS cites 5.9 Moz proven and probable reserves at a $1,950/oz gold price, 5.6 Moz planned production over 29 years (258 koz/year in years 1-17), a $2.8 billion after-tax NPV at 5% and 31.5% IRR at $3,600/oz, and an initial funding requirement of $1,005 million. No transaction, stake, price per share or board recommendation is involved; construction decision targeted early 2027. This is a routine project technical update, not a special situation.
